name: Hybrid Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hybrid Technologies Co., Ltd. develops software for clients in Japan and Vietnam. Its services include helping incubate new businesses and services, UX and UI design, and various development approaches such as laboratory-style R&D, contract projects, hybrid models, Agile Scrum and development on Salesforce. It also supports project management and provides on-site development teams. Dating from 2016, it has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
